name: Nyunzu

queries.query: Nyunzu Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral parcel map official land registry Tanganyika
queries.result: Discovery found the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs site and national registry-consultation procedure. No first-party Nyunzu parcel viewer, public parcel API, or Nyunzu-specific cadastral map was found. The BIC site advertises coverage only for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, not Tanganyika.

queries.query: Nyunzu cadastre parcelles registre foncier officiel RDC Tanganyika
queries.result: La recherche officielle a trouvé le Ministère des Affaires Foncières, la procédure nationale de consultation des registres et la page des circonscriptions foncières. La page des circonscriptions ne contient pas Nyunzu comme circonscription; aucune carte ou API publique de parcelles à Nyunzu n'a été trouvée.

registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official sources document national land/cadastre administration and a request-based registry consultation procedure. They do not establish an open local Nyunzu parcel map or API, so registryFound remains null rather than true.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Land Affairs site describes land and cadastral administration and publishes a pilot cadastral-digitization project.
Official directory of 143 land/cadastral jurisdictions was retrieved; Tanganyika entries were visible, but Nyunzu was not present in the rendered directory.
Official public-service catalogue describes paid, request-based consultation through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre; it is not an open parcel-vector service.
A cadastral information site was retrieved and advertises parcel data for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu only; it does not evidence Tanganyika/Nyunzu coverage.
